title: Table 3.9a Maximum overshadowing: adjoining property (percentage of dwelling site area)

rows.note: R80 or higher: no maximum overshadowing

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Site area is the ground surface measured at NGL without regard to buildings. Footnote 1: where the development adjoins a grouped dwelling development the limit applies to each grouped dwelling site area excluding common property (Figure 3.9d). Named codes (R100-SL, LR, MR, HR) have no row.
